causal_detection.purpose: numerical causal detection only; not engineering significance
causal_detection.rule: PCM SHA must differ and absolute metric delta must exceed this numerical floor.

evidence_basis.known_engineering_scale: metric-specific absolute and relative floors above
evidence_basis.repeat_render_max_abs_delta: measured per metric during AA0 audit
evidence_basis.scenario_variance: Stage-Z ablation baselines and AA1 scene ledger

crest_db.reason: Crest-factor changes need a quarter-dB movement to exceed numerical and windowing sensitivity.

dynamic_range_db.estimation_method: max(repeat-render/quantization floor, 5% of baseline, 0.25 dB engineering resolution)
dynamic_range_db.reason: A dynamic-range effect must exceed a quarter dB and five percent of the baseline envelope range.

narrowband_whine_proxy.estimation_method: max(10x quantization sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 10% baseline resolution, 0.01 absolute resolution)
narrowband_whine_proxy.reason: Whine dominance needs a one-percent absolute and ten-percent relative movement to be treated as an engineering effect.

peak_dbfs.estimation_method: max(10x PCM24 peak sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 0.5 dB engineering resolution)
peak_dbfs.reason: Peak changes smaller than half a dB are not treated as a meaningful headroom or impact change.

persistent_tone_ratio.estimation_method: max(10x quantization sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 5% baseline resolution, 0.02 absolute resolution)
persistent_tone_ratio.reason: A two-percentage-point move is the minimum stable change in carrier persistence.

rms_dbfs.estimation_method: max(10x PCM24 level sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 0.5 dB engineering resolution)
rms_dbfs.reason: A half-dB level move is above digital measurement noise and is audible in a matched diagnostic comparison.

roughness_proxy.estimation_method: max(10x quantization sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 5% baseline resolution, 0.01 absolute resolution)
roughness_proxy.reason: The proxy needs at least a 0.01 absolute and five-percent move to distinguish texture from numerical variation.

sharpness_proxy.estimation_method: max(10x quantization sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 5% baseline resolution, 0.01 absolute resolution)
sharpness_proxy.reason: The proxy needs at least a 0.01 absolute and five-percent move; a SHA change alone is insufficient.

spectral_centroid_hz.estimation_method: max(10x PCM24 round-trip sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 0.5% of 1 kHz reference scale, 5 Hz engineering resolution)
spectral_centroid_hz.reason: Centroid movement must exceed small-bin/quantization sensitivity and one half percent of a kilohertz-scale baseline; 0.000359 Hz is therefore below significance.

spectral_flux.estimation_method: max(10x PCM24 round-trip sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 10% baseline resolution, 0.001 absolute resolution)
spectral_flux.reason: Flux is a normalized proxy; a ten-percent and 0.001 absolute move is required to exceed frame-window sensitivity.

tonality_proxy.estimation_method: max(10x quantization sensitivity, repeat-render floor, 5% baseline resolution, 0.01 absolute resolution)
tonality_proxy.reason: Tonality proxy movement must exceed a one-percent absolute and five-percent relative threshold.

transient_event_density_per_s.estimation_method: max(one event over a four-second ablation window, 10% relative resolution)
transient_event_density_per_s.reason: One quarter event per second is the minimum stable change for a bounded scene-level event-density claim.
